title: Looking for character artists for books (no AI)
content: Looking for character artists who have openings to do some character art for a few of my published and upcoming books!! (Absolutely no AI). Contact via DM on Threads or Instagram.

author: Sega Jenesis
title: Looking for digital artists for Pokémon binder scenes
content: I’m on the hunt for digital artists! I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Obviously, this is a PAID commission! Contact via DM on Threads. Portfolios, pricing, and availability welcome.

author: McKenna Roszkowski
title: Looking to commission character art for YA fantasy novel
content: Calling all fantasy character artists! I’m looking to commission character art for my YA fantasy novel! I have a particular art style in mind, but I’d love to explore different artists and their work! Please drop your portfolio or commission links below!

author: Aurora Crate Book Box
title: Looking for artists with availability for book box
content: We’re looking for some artists with availability between now and the end of 2026. Self recs welcome, please include price list + some examples. No dms please. Also to clarify, NO AI - human artists only please. Contact via replies on Threads.

author: Or Cole
title: Looking for character artist for upcoming book (flexible payment)
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please! Contact via DM or replies on Threads.
